scope: One parameter-chosen upright neutral axial guide, sampled at native y=7.5mm/z=axleZ, not an installed assembly or hardware-sizing result. No rake or clocking inferred.
interpretation: Open intervals depend on the175mm estimated spacing and unverified panel clocking/position. They neither specify a collar identity nor certify an axial stack.
